faqs.q: What size generator do I need for my home?
faqs.a: Many factors affect generator sizing and your home's power needs, including how often you expect an outage. Kelm Home Services determines which home standby generator suits your home, and a free quote includes sizing options and price.

faqs.q: Where can a generator be placed or installed?
faqs.a: Outside your home, typically close to the fuel source, whether that is a propane tank or a natural gas meter. We also carry out a site survey to settle on the best location, following the site selection and preparation guidelines in the installation manual.

faqs.q: Can I install a home standby generator myself?
faqs.a: Permanent installation of a standby generator is not a do-it-yourself project. Kelm Home Services has factory-trained technicians who meet Generac's high standards for service and customer satisfaction.

faqs.q: How often should my generator be serviced?
faqs.a: Once a year. Just like a car, air-cooled backup generators need to be properly maintained to perform as intended, and our factory-trained technicians handle all Generac servicing needs.

faqs.q: Where do I find the owner's manual for my generator?
faqs.a: Use the online product support lookup on the Generac.com website. You can find your manual with your model number or your serial number.

faqs.q: Who do I ask about my Generac warranty?
faqs.a: Contact Generac directly at 888-GENERAC (888-436-3722). To ensure accurate warranty coverage, make sure your equipment is registered at register.generac.com, which also gives you proof of purchase in the event of an insurance loss such as fire, flood or theft.
